description: Rows after the table Sheets finds at an A1 range (values.append), as new rows (INSERT_ROWS) or over empty ones (OVERWRITE). Returns where they went. Not retried after a lost answer, since a retry would add them twice. append_rows is the variant keyed by a header row.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

range.description: Where the table is, e.g. "Sheet1!A1" or "Sheet1!A:E".

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet's id, or its URL.

value_input.description: USER_ENTERED parses as if typed ("=SUM(A:A)" a formula, "2026-10-08" a date, "12.5" a number); RAW stores strings as text.

values.description: Rows of cells (columns with major_dimension COLUMNS). null leaves a cell as it is; "" empties it.

name: append_values
title: Append rows after a table
